info.name: Retrieve a paginated list of accounting vendors

params.name: detail
params.description: Specify the level of detail in the response

params.name: last_modified_date_from
params.description: Filter vendors last modified on or after this date. Requires ottimate_company_id. Accepted formats: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. All times are interpreted as UTC. A date-only value is treated as 00:00:00 UTC.

params.name: last_modified_date_from_utc
params.description: UTC filter. Accepts ISO 8601 with optional Z/offset, or YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS] (assumed UTC). Takes precedence over the non-_utc variant.

params.name: last_modified_date_to
params.description: Filter vendors last modified on or before this date. Requires ottimate_company_id. Accepted formats: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. All times are interpreted as UTC. A date-only value is treated as 00:00:00 UTC — to include the full day pass an explicit time (e.g. 2024-12-31 23:59:59).

params.name: last_modified_date_to_utc
params.description: UTC filter. Accepts ISO 8601 with optional Z/offset, or YYYY-MM-DD[ HH:MM:SS] (assumed UTC). Takes precedence over the non-_utc variant.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of accounting vendors, filterable by company. The `detail=basic` query parameter returns a simplified response.

info.name: Create a single new accounting vendor

items.docs: Creates a new vendor with the provided details. The `erp_vendor_id` is required and will be mapped to both `accounting_id` and `dd_unique_key`.

info.name: Retrieve a specific vendor by ID

params.name: id
params.description: The unique ID of the vendor

items.docs: Returns detailed information for a single accounting vendor using its unique ID.

info.name: Create or update multiple accounting vendors

items.docs: Allows for the creation or updating of multiple vendors in a single request. Maximum 100 vendors per request.
